rationale: The endpoint-matching hypothesis failed before any interannual displacement was calculated.
The publication states that fast-ice-edge distances were measured from the colony location in the first image of each season.

The published route DBF stores pointLon/pointLat in addition to the route polyline, so the appropriate semantic test is whether that point behaves as a single season-level anchor rather than whether the polyline vertex order begins at it.

validation.coordinate_constancy_rule: Within each colony-season, all finite point_lon/point_lat values must be identical after rounding to 8 decimal places.

interpretation_if_passed: Treat the unique point_lon/point_lat pair per colony-season as the published first-image annual colony anchor for the interannual aliasing analysis.
prohibited: use of interannual displacement to decide semantic validity
choice of radii from anchor distances
